messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Sasha Ivanov <sasha@acmecorp.com>
Cc: AWS Partner PM <aws-partner-pm@amazon.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Catalog listing storyboard & partner enablement — AcmeCorp AWS listing

Hi team / Sasha,

Quick context: Acme is targeting an early-Nov launch on AWS Marketplace and asked us to help with the catalog page narrative, hero messaging, and a short co-sell enablement one-pager for their field. They provided a first pass (attached) and a spreadsheet of SKUs / entitlements.

Can Kimberly and Jonas take a pass on the hero and bullets for clarity and compliance? Ben — can you add a short sales-first CTA and example one-liner we can surface in co-sell assets? Sasha — flag anything here that would break your procurement/AMI flow.

Attachments: marketplace_hero_v3.png, pricing_table_v2.xlsx, co-sell_playbook_v1.pdf

Goals for this thread:
- Finalize 2 hero options (short + long) by EOD Sep 17
- Agree on entitlement wording for the SKU table
- Circulate co-sell one-pager to Acme field and AWS Partner PM the week of Sep 21

Thanks — Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Senior Partner Rep, GTM
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Sasha Ivanov <sasha@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Catalog listing storyboard & partner enablement — AcmeCorp AWS listing

Rafael — thanks, looping back with initial edits inline below. I also uploaded a short redline doc to the Google link (see related_links).

High level notes:
- Hero: keep it benefit-led (cost/latency) + a concrete example ("Reduce inference cost by up to 3x for retrieval-augmented apps"). Option A (short) is more marketplace-friendly; Option B (long) works for product page.
- Bullets: split technical vs business benefits; remove any absolute numbered claims unless we have a benchmark doc to attach.
- SKU wording: change "unit" to "inference-unit" for clarity across AMI/privateoffer rows.

Inline suggestion (Option A hero):
> High-throughput LLM inference, optimized for production: predictable latency, built-in batching, and predictable cost per request.

Attachment note: I pulled the pricing sheet and flagged mismatched SKU IDs in column C — see pricing_table_v2.xlsx (comments).

Quick ask for Ben: can you provide 2 sales one-liners by EOD Monday? I want to include a short "why now" for field enablement.

-Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Director, Marketplace & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Sasha Ivanov <sasha@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Catalog listing storyboard & partner enablement — AcmeCorp AWS listing

Quick from sales side — two options attached inline below (feel free to shorten):

1) "Try latency-safe LLM inference at production scale — deploy in minutes on AWS Marketplace and lower inference TCO with out-of-the-box batching and cache."
2) "Ship features faster: preconfigured models, predictable pricing tiers, and co-sell support to accelerate procurement."

CTA suggestion for marketplace CTA button: "Start a free trial" vs. "Request a demo" — recommend "Start free trial" for PLG momentum on first page, with a secondary CTA in the co-sell packet to contact partner team.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Americas
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@acmecorp.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-16T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Catalog listing storyboard & partner enablement — AcmeCorp AWS listing

Thanks all — this looks helpful. A couple quick clarifications from Acme's legal/procurement side:

- Entitlement model: we need to be explicit about trial entitlements vs paid SKU allocations. If "inference-unit" is the term, we need a short definition on the product page to avoid confusion during procurement review.
- Co-sell ask: can Redwood provide a 1-page summary for our field that includes target ICP, recommended demo script, and top five objection-handling bullets? The attached co-sell_playbook_v1.pdf is a good start but we need the demo script specifically.

If you can update the one-pager and add a 30s demo script, we can circulate internally and share with AWS for the co-sell sync on Sep 22.

Thanks — Sasha

--
Sasha Ivanov
Head of Marketplace GTM, AcmeCorp
sasha@acmecorp.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Sasha Ivanov <sasha@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-09-17T16:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Catalog listing storyboard & partner enablement — AcmeCorp AWS listing

Pushed a revised hero and updated bullet set to the shared doc (link above). Main edits: tightened language, removed absolute percent claims, and added a short definition block for "inference-unit" under the SKU table.

Proposed 30s demo script (high-level):
- 0–10s: Show latency comparison on a retrieval-augmented demo (search -> response)
- 10–20s: Toggle to lower-cost config (quantized model + batching) and show throughput numbers
- 20–30s: Point to the Marketplace tile and call out free trial + procurement path (private offer link)

Attachments: marketplace_hero_v3.png (annotated)

Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Product Marketing Manager, GTM Enablement
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Sasha Ivanov <sasha@acmecorp.com>
Cc: AWS Partner PM <aws-partner-pm@amazon.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T17:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Catalog listing storyboard & partner enablement — AcmeCorp AWS listing

Thanks everyone — good progress. Summary & next steps:

1) Copy sign-off (Rafael/Kim): choose Option A hero for the Marketplace tile and Option B for extended product page by Sep 22 — OWNER: Rafael.
2) SKU language: Jonas will finalize the "inference-unit" definition and sync with Acme procurement — OWNER: Jonas; ETA Sep 21.
3) Co-sell one-pager: Jonas + Ben to produce final 1-pager with 30s demo script and top objections; Ben to add field-facing one-liners. Deliverable due Sep 21 EOD.
4) Marketplace submission: Rafael will prepare the listing package and submit to AWS on Sep 23 for an early-Nov target window. Link to draft in related_links.

Attachments referenced above are the working assets. Sasha — once we deliver the co-sell packet (Sep 21), can you confirm if Acme will route a single private offer or multiple SKUs per account for procurement? That will determine the AMI/privateoffer mapping.

If no objections, we’ll lock the hero and push the co-sell packet into Acme's field distribution on Sep 22.

Thanks — Rafael
